read-ai-alternative.0: Why do teams go looking for a Read AI alternative? Three reasons, mostly. The free plan stops at 5 meetings a month, the bot joins calls people did not expect it in, or the summaries are good but nobody acts on them.
read-ai-alternative.1: Read AI is a capable product. Meetings on Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams get summarized, engagement and talk time get scored, and you get coached on how you ran the call. Value those metrics? Stay. Want something else from your meetings? The seven tools below are where US teams are moving.
read-ai-alternative.2: The most common trigger is the free plan limit: 5 meeting transcripts, 5 reports and 5 live-note sessions a month, each capped at 1 hour. Past that, you pay. Pro costs $19.75 per user per month, or $15 billed yearly.
read-ai-alternative.4: Read AI costs $15 to $29.75 per user per month on annual billing. Most Read AI competitors sit in a similar band. Fireflies Pro is $10, Granola Business $14 and Lynkk $15.
read-ai-alternative.5: Sources: [Read AI pricing](https://www.read.ai/plans-pricing), [Otter pricing](https://otter.ai/pricing), [Fathom pricing](https://www.fathom.ai/pricing) and other vendor pages, checked 17 October 2026. Every Read AI tier is broken down in our [Read AI pricing guide](https://lynkk.ai/blog/read-ai-pricing).
read-ai-alternative.6: Each Read AI alternative was judged on 4 things: free limits, price per user, privacy controls, and what happens once the meeting ends.
read-ai-alternative.7: Online meetings on Zoom, Google Meet and Teams get a Lynkk bot; in-person conversations and bot-free calls go through the Mac app and Chrome extension. Read AI measures the meeting. Lynkk acts on it.
read-ai-alternative.8: Supported: 17 languages plus auto-detect, Hindi and Hinglish included. Teams can also pin data to the US, EU, UK, India, Singapore or Australia. Free covers 5 notes a month; Pro is $15 a month.
read-ai-alternative.9: Otter shows a live transcript during the call and answers questions about it afterward. On the free plan you get 300 minutes a month, but each conversation stops at 30 minutes, and Pro costs $8.33 a month billed yearly. Full comparison: [Read AI vs Otter AI](https://lynkk.ai/blog/read-ai-vs-otter-ai).
read-ai-alternative.10: Fireflies pushes call notes into CRMs and offers search across every call. Pricing: $10 per seat billed yearly for Pro, $19 for Business. Watch for storage limits on lower tiers. Some AI features also use credits.
read-ai-alternative.11: Unlimited recordings and transcripts on the free plan make Fathom the strongest free Read AI alternative. Premium is $16 a month billed yearly. Need CRM field sync? Business adds it at $25.
read-ai-alternative.12: No bot ever joins: Granola captures audio from your device and turns your rough typed notes into full ones. Business costs $14 per user per month. For its limits, see our [Granola AI alternatives guide](https://lynkk.ai/blog/granola-ai-alternatives).
read-ai-alternative.13: Jamie records without a bot, hosts data in the EU and lists 99+ languages. Its free tier: 10 notes a month, up to 30 minutes each. Team runs $37 per seat billed yearly.
read-ai-alternative.14: Running on Microsoft 365? Then Teams' AI recap features come with a Microsoft 365 Copilot license, so you may already pay for them. The catch: they stay inside Teams. Zoom calls and in-person meetings are not covered. Options are compared in our [Teams AI note takers guide](https://lynkk.ai/blog/ai-note-taker-microsoft-teams).
read-ai-alternative.15: Read AI does 4 things well, and it helps to know them before switching. Engagement and talk-time analytics. A personal meeting coach. Native apps on Windows, Mac, Android and iOS. And premium integrations on Pro, including Notion, Confluence, Salesforce, HubSpot, Jira and Zapier.
read-ai-alternative.16: Chose Read AI for those reasons? Then compare alternatives on the same points: Fathom Business offers coaching metrics and scorecards, Otter and Fireflies offer broad integrations, and Lynkk focuses on prep before meetings and tasks after them rather than engagement scoring.
read-ai-alternative.18: Hiring? See our guide to [interview transcription for hiring teams](https://lynkk.ai/blog/recruiting-interview-transcription).
read-ai-alternative.19: Yes. Fathom is the most generous free Read AI alternative, with unlimited recordings and transcripts. Smaller allowances: Otter gives 300 free minutes a month, Jamie 10 notes, and Lynkk 5 notes a month with tasks and Jira send included.
read-ai-alternative.20: Since Read AI's own free plan stops at 5 meetings, even the smallest free plans above are comparable. What matters more is meeting length. Otter and Jamie both cap free recordings at 30 minutes, which rules out hour-long calls, while Lynkk allows up to 2 hours per note.
read-ai-alternative.21: Read AI's top tier, Enterprise+ ($29.75 billed yearly), adds SAML, SCIM, domain capture, HIPAA compliance and custom retention. Most concerns, though, are about control rather than security. Who can send the notetaker into a meeting?

read-ai-alternative.23: For teams of 5 to 50, the best Read AI alternatives are Fireflies (CRM sync), Fathom Team ($15 per user billed yearly, 2-user minimum) and Lynkk (Jira tasks and shared meeting memory). None of them carries the 5-seat minimum of Read AI's Enterprise tier.
read-ai-alternative.26: The best Read AI alternative for most teams is the one that matches the follow-up work they do after calls. Want tasks and Jira tickets? Lynkk suits you. Fireflies suits CRM-driven sales teams. Anyone who wants free unlimited recording should start with Fathom.
read-ai-alternative.27: Yes. Fathom offers unlimited free recordings and transcripts. Otter, Jamie and Lynkk have free plans too, capped at 300 minutes, 10 notes and 5 notes a month respectively. For light use, even the smallest of these is comparable, because Read AI's own free plan stops at 5 meetings a month.
read-ai-alternative.28: Microsoft's alternative is the AI recap in Teams, which comes with a Microsoft 365 Copilot license. Inside Teams it works well. Zoom, Google Meet and in-person meetings are not covered, though. No Copilot license at your company? Then a third-party tool that joins Teams calls is usually the more affordable route.
read-ai-alternative.29: Read AI's main competitors are Otter.ai, Fireflies.ai, Fathom, Granola, tl;dv, Jamie and Lynkk. Their approaches differ, from live transcription to bot-free notes to automated follow-up. When comparing, look at free limits, price per user, privacy controls and what happens after the meeting.
read-ai-alternative.30: Yes. Granola and Jamie are bot-free by design, and Lynkk gives you both options: a bot for Zoom, Meet and Teams, or bot-free recording through its Mac app and Chrome extension. Remember that bot-free capture still records. Announce it at the start of each call, especially with clients.
read-ai-alternative.31: Yes, Lynkk supports Hindi and has a Hinglish setting for conversations that mix Hindi and English. Read AI lists 20+ languages; check that list against what your team speaks. Before rolling out any tool, test it on a real meeting in each of those languages.
